submitted.rationale: I measured EQE at three compositions: 12 (Sb 0.46) gave 0.012%, 17 (Sb 0.61) gave 0.037%, and 21 (Sb 0.73) gave 0.045%. EQE rose steadily as the film became more Sb-rich, which fits the known high activity of Sb-rich rutile-type Cr-Sb oxides. Index 21 had the highest measured merit.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.012% EQE; the near-stoichiometric CrSbO4 region performs poorly.
